d:
A spindly, hooded entity with shriveled, midnight purple skin and glowing violet eyes recessed deep within a skeletal face. The body is gaunt and frail, draped in tattered, obsidian black robes that hide the legs. It possesses long, spindly arms with three sharp, obsidian claws on each hand and a long, whip-like tail of the same dark hue.
BODY COLOR: midnight purple
